title: Corona Ranch & Rodeo Grounds

services.name: Team Building
services.desc: Since 1991, Arizona Banquets & Events has specialized in delivering an event that you can be proud of. Whether it is our incredible rodeo, our 13 tree-filled acres of landscaped grounds, or our outstanding food & drinks, you can count on us to make you look like a star. Did we love it when Tim McGraw played for the number one car company in the world? Sure. When Maroon Five played for the NBA All Star Game party? Yep. Taylor Swift for a giant entertainment company? You bet. But the truth of the matter is, we all know those budgets are few and far between. Let us help you tailor something that fits your budget and is a Home Run for your team.
